text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, melon or lemon, which one should I pick... Hmmmmmm."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Um, Ticket-san.
If you're okay with lemon, would you like a taste?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, really?! Yay!
Then gimme a bite, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, hold on. A 'bite' from Ticket
is never just a bite."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even Ticket would show some restraint, right? Wouldn't she?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please, have as much as you like!
I bought it because of the heat,
but I've cooled down plenty by now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really is hot today.
I can't take it without some shaved ice.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? Ah, Hayahide-san, why not tie your hair up?
I've got a hair tie if you need one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, could you lend it to me? Mine snapped while I was running earlier, you see...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...And like that, by chiming in to match BNW's vibe,
I was able to have a pretty nice conversation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Distance really is key, isn't it?
I'll interact with them more and gradually close the gap
so that we can have deeper conversations.
choice_data_list: Looks like this is gonna take a while, huh...?
Looks like this might take a while...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's the thing, the time it takes is a real bottleneck... It'd be nice to have a way to grow closer all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even from an objective standpoint,
they were definitely growing closer.
The atmosphere between them was shifting too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, at this rate, it might be tough to get
close during the training camp.
To take a giant leap forward in our bond—"
choice_data_list: Increase how often we interact and how deep those interactions are...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
then maybe I can be of help—!

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: A two-day, one-night high-altitude training trip!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was Trainer's idea,
as the final touch to wrap up our summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I was told I could invite people along,
so would you all like to join as well?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm goooing! Absolutely, totally going!
High-altitude training sounds so fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was just looking to work on my cardiopulmonary function.
I would be delighted if you'd let me join in as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm going. I was just about to switch to a harder training regimen anyway, so the timing is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have Trainer make the arrangements!
Please take care of me for the two days♪
choice_data_list: (The stage is set. The rest is up to Royce...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a huge crowd at camp. Getting BNW's attention
on Lois and Lois would be tough. So, I created
a situation that would draw their eyes naturally.
choice_data_list: I know you can make good use of this environment, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The air is seriously thin...
Looks like this'll be great training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, plus it seems we'll be able to gather strategic case data as well,
which is much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a ranch just ahead.
Why don't we jog over there as a warm-up?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"A ranch! Sounds great, let's go!
I wonder if there are animals~♪"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I have already drafted a routine for these two days.
I would like to proceed according to the plan.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Count me in.
I want to focus on my own.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yeah, okay!
Then let's go together, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Oh my... Unexpectedly, we're all alone. How lucky.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Alright then, to deepen our bonds with BNW――
we'll proceed by approaching them individually!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"We're here! Whewww,
just thin air alone tires you out this much...!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, cows! They're selling soft-serve ice cream, too.
...I guess I can't bring soft-serve back as a souvenir, huh.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like it might be difficult.
...It's a little surprising, though.
I thought Hayahide-san and the others were coming, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, before debut, maybe.
But... lately we mostly do our own thing.
Because on the track, we're rivals...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, but... ehehe,
I might feel just a tiny bit lonely.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...You want to share the fun things
with someone else, after all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Exactly!
Like, being moved together when something's delicious, or yelling out when it tastes awful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. ...Ticket-san.
Would you like to have some soft serve with me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
! Yeah!!
Let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Ticket is someone who loves to share fun times with her friends.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Hayahide-san is data-driven, similar to me. But when it comes to collecting and analyzing race data, I'm no match for her.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san,
what kind of lens guards do you use for your glasses?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I apply a coating agent, but the lifespan of my lenses is rather short...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, racing lenses?
There's a maintenance kit that helps prevent the coating from peeling.
I'll tell you which shops carry it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, thank you very much!
By the way, Hayahide-san, what size grains of sand can this coating protect against without scratching?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: In my case, when running at 60 km/h, medium-grained sand leaves me about 87% undamaged—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
! You collect detailed data on glasses too?!
Tell me more.
What's the brand name of the coating agent?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Taishin-san is... likely immune to cheap tricks. That's why I have to face her head-on—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Just a little further to the top.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haaah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't see anything anymore...!
Damn it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Haaah!
...I-I finally... caught up...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I knew it.
You were following me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
I-I'm sorry, I just went ahead without asking...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
However... watching your back slip further away,
I just couldn't help but want to catch up...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I can kind of understand that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If we're takin' a break, over there...
looks pretty breezy, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So that whole thing between Hayahide and Royce
was just about glasses?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They were getting super hyped up talking about complicated stuff,
so everyone was saying they really are both geniuses!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She had such a serious look on her face,
I totally thought it was about racing...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, it is related to racing, you know?
For us, how comfortable our glasses feel
directly affects how easily we can run!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You folks couldn't possibly understand
the struggle of wearing glasses on a bad track!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With mud and grass sticking all over you,
there are times when your vision goes completely to zero for a second!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To be able to share so much glasses-related
data like this...!
This might just be the greatest achievement of the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then let's pray for clear skies at the Kikuka Sho!
It'd be boring if Hayahide and Royce couldn't give it their all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, rain poses no issue.
You all know that well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that you mention it, that's true!
It never mattered to Hayahide's running!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Um... would it be all right if I asked
all the details about how you all met...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, but where is this coming from all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Um, I know the background, but I don't know how they came to acknowledge each other...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: In your running, you each acknowledge one another! Your strength, your dreams—all of it belongs to the three of you together, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That was so wonderful, I felt so jealous!
I wanted to get to know everyone and build a bond like that too...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What is that? So cringe!
You can't just say that with a straight face...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Uwaaaaaaaah! Thank youuuuuuu!
To hear you say that... I just, I just—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm zo haaaappyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's a bit embarrassing,
but I agree with the ticket."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind chatting at all.
I've been wanting to get to know you better, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the final day of the training camp arrived—
choice_data_list: How was the two-day, one-night training camp with BNW?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was so meaningful!
I was able to get to know the three of them so much better...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We ended up talking
until almost midnight that day!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First, let's hear about how BNW first met.
Surprisingly, their first impressions of each other were—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She happily talked on and on about her night with BNW.
She looked so joyous sharing it that I didn't have the heart to interrupt, silently listening until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —And on the drive back, I fell asleep while we were talking about our elementary school days.
choice_data_list: I see. So... how is the progress coming along?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Progress?
...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly, I think we really bonded! I'm super confident in my youthful vibe! Gotta show that off in the Kikuka Sho too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her reaction was as if she had forgotten all about being produced.
It felt like she was truly immersing herself in her youth with BNW,
not just putting on an act.
